dialogue.t: Look at the time! What am I going to do now... They'll be here any minute...
Hello, Nicole, we're heeeere! Hey, why are you pushing us out?
Oh dear, oh dear... I'm sorry about this...
How should I put this... Oh, blast, I'm afraid I can't explain it very clearly. I'll have to tell you the whole story...
It all started the first time the mages challenged the Anemo Archon...
Nicole, that's... way too long ago!

Ugh, this isn't fair! It's so embarrassing that you'd end up having to hear this from my own mouth... No! It can't be helped, the facts are the facts... Just so long as Alice doesn't hear about this, there's no reason for anyone to laugh...
Oh dear, her inner monologue's leaking out again... Besides, it's not really coming from her own "mouth"...
I decided to hide the feathers at the top of the study. I figured if I made things harder, there'd be a greater sense of accomplishment...
But I'm really not very good at controlling these carefree eddies. I can only fly so high before I seem to hit an invisible ceiling.
Can't you use magic to bring the feathers back down?
Where would be the fun in that!?
Oh, Paimon sees your point... Hmm, that sure is a tricky one...

dialogue.sit: Nicole, could you try saying something?

dialogue.t: What do you want me to say?

dialogue.sit: Maybe you could say something that will become a staircase...

dialogue.t: Oh! I get what you're saying! Alright, I'll give it a try!

dialogue.sit: Ugh, this isn't fair! It's so embarrassing that you'd end up having to hear this from my own mouth...
No! It can't be helped, the facts are the facts...
Just so long as Alice doesn't hear about this, there's no reason for anyone to laugh...

dialogue.t: Nicole, this is a dead end!
Leave it to me.
Whoa, it really worked! Say something else!
Leave it to me! Leave it to me! Leave it to me!
Eh... You're just repeating yourself...
Whoa, that gap's so big!

All things may serve as guides... The scriptures filled... with names divine! The words and chapters... intertwine... and angels act with deeds aligned! In this sacred place, let words forge the path ahead.
See? All taken care of.

dialogue.sit: All things may serve as guides... The scriptures filled... with names divine!
The words and chapters... intertwine... and angels act with deeds aligned!
In this sacred place, let words forge the path ahead.

dialogue.t: Treasure! Woohoo, this is so much fun!
But... Paimon's head really is pounding. Seriously, did Nicole actually need to shout that loud just to make those stairs appear...?
What's this? Complaining now, are we? Aren't you worried a powerful mage like me might snap her fingers and turn those new trinkets into turnips?

dialogue.sit: P—Paimon didn't mean anything by it...
Come on, don't take it to heart...

dialogue.t: Hehe, I'm only joking with you. You should know I'm not the silent, sulking sort of angel that keeps track of every little slight.
...And so, when their day of reckoning finally arrived, {NICKNAME} and Paimon ascended the seven-tiered steps to find a familiar figure awaiting them.
Radiant flames converged to form wings upon her back. Her figure remained as noble and beautiful as the day they first met, yet her eyes now shone with a cruel light.
"But why?" asked {NICKNAME} and Paimon in unison.
"It all started the day Paimon complained that I shouted too loudly!"
Hey! Words are magic here, don't you know! Don't say such scary things!
